messages:
alejandro: Quick broadcast  putting a temporary hold on the release train due to unexpected GPU node evictions in us-west. Pause estimated ~36h, will update sooner if infra stabilizes. Please avoid new train submissions for the next 2 hours. :warning:

deploy-bot: [automated] canary-check: 12/48 canaries degraded in region=us-west. Dashboard: https://internal.ops/canary-dashboard

samira: If a team has a critical enterprise hotfix, what's the exception path? :question:

alejandro: @samira - open a ticket in the release-train board labelled "release-exception" + ping me and @ops-oncall. Exceptions = P0 customer hotfixes only. We will triage within 30m.

linda: For Dedicated customers: will this affect reserved capacity commitments next week?

ops-oncall: Dedicated pools are not impacted by the eviction events in us-west. However autoscaler rebalancing may shift some background capacity; teams with strict SLAs should escalate to #infra-allocations. :eyes:

matt: Heads-up this may delay the hotfix cycle. Recommend moving any non-urgent PRs to next window. :arrow_right:

alejandro: Rebalancing plan: reassign non-pinned canaries to eu-west and apac-regional to keep validation moving. If you require us-west specifically, add a comment to the canary ticket with `infra:pin=us-west` and we will skip reassignment.

deploy-bot: Helpful command to inspect canary status by team/region:
```
rictl canary status --team=<team> --region=eu-west
```

alejandro: Owners of re-assigned canaries will get automated DMs. I'll post a status update in ~3h. Thanks for the quick coordination, please surface any urgent blockers here. :thumbsup:
